summary: Bounded re-review replaced the framework-test scaffold with source-reviewed rows for this sublancin paper. The final outcome is accepted_with_cautions: primary source supports immunomodulatory/transport/toxicity-threshold evidence, while database-only antimicrobial/anticancer annotations and exact image-only bar values remain explicit cautions rather than fabricated rows.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered source-supported activity/toxicity/transport rows; worker-4 preserved DRAMP/CAMP source conflicts and database-only annotations; worker-6 closed rwk-complete-test-0001 with cautions after strict gates were rerun.

materials_exhausted.supplementary_assets_note: No standalone supplementary table assets were present; the OA package contains Figure S1 as DOCX image-only media and XML/PDF caption text.
materials_exhausted.local_source_exhaustion: All handoff-listed local material surfaces relevant to worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 blockers were opened or inventoried.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/DRAMP literature links trace to the selected DOI/PMID. DRAMP and CAMP activity/experiment annotations are not primary-source antimicrobial/anticancer assay rows in this article; they remain source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source with sequence/modification caveats.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The primary paper supports immunomodulatory activity, hemogram recovery, Caco-2 transport, and Caco-2 no-cytotoxicity-threshold rows. No primary MIC/MBC antimicrobial table is present, and database-only MIC labels were not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to host-response immunomodulation and poor intestinal absorption/retention context; no direct antimicrobial killing mechanism is claimed from this article.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final: The original open ticket is resolved by paper-specific source review. Remaining limitations are cautions, not open rework targets, because exact figure bar heights are image-only and database-only activity annotations are preserved rather than smoothed.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The selected paper discusses sublancin as an antimicrobial peptide and cites prior antibacterial work, but this article reports immunomodulatory, Caco-2 transport, cytotoxicity-threshold, biodistribution, and hemogram outcomes rather than MIC/MBC assays.
Figures 1, 3, 4, and Figure S1 are available as images/captions without source data tables; exact bar heights were not asserted.
DRAMP/CAMP activity labels include antimicrobial/anticancer/MIC-like annotations that this primary paper does not report.
DRAMP sequence uses X while the primary paper prints C in the glycosylated sublancin sequence; the difference is preserved rather than normalized.
Antibacterial activity is background/cited context here; no MIC/MBC mechanism row is supported by this primary paper.
Host-response mechanism is supported by phagocytosis, cytokine, hemogram, and transport assays rather than a direct molecular target.

resolved_qc_failure_reasons.resolution: Worker-6 reopened handoff, XML/PDF text, OA package, figure captions/images, supplementary DOCX metadata, and linked database rows; final review now contains paper-specific provenance and layer rationale.
DRAMP/CAMP activity rows were preserved as source_conflict/database_only_no_primary_source with sequence/status caveats and traceability.
Worker-2 repair wrote source-supported immunomodulatory, hemogram, Caco-2 transport, and Caco-2 cytotoxicity rows with locators.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The paper-local material provides figure images, captions, prose significance statements, and one Caco-2 table, but no numeric source-data table for exact bar heights or SEM values in Figures 1, 3, 4, or Figure S1. Visual digitization would be approximate rather than source-extracted.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Qualitative/statistical activity claims and exact Table 1 transport values are retained; exact figure bar heights are not asserted as numeric source values.
